name: Gaignun Kukai Jr.
original_name: ガイナン・クーカイ・Jr.
source: Gaignun Kukai Jr., director of Kukai Foundation. His hobby is collecting ancient text and literature, as well as ancient (relative to his time period) weapons. The official records state that he was born in T.C. 4755 and is the adopted son of Gaignun Kukai.
